title: Church leaders: Our Attention is Sacred
description: Church leaders  Structure community within real human capacity.
content:
## Church leaders

Structure community within real human capacity. The Dunbar layers — anthropologist Robin Dunbar's nested limits of human relationship: roughly 150 acquaintances, 50 casual friends, 15 close, 5 intimate — are the created limits of relational attention; design your congregation's groups, care structures, and expectations to honor them rather than pretending one pastor or one feed can hold everyone. And protect the sacred hour: audit Sunday itself for engineered distraction — countdown clocks, announcements, production — asking of each element the Mary question: does this help people sit down at Jesus' feet?
